title: Revealing a Centrally Condensed Structure in OMC-3/MMS 3 with ALMA High-resolution Observations
question: Is the peculiar millimeter source MMS 3 in OMC-3 a prestellar core or a protostar, and what are its envelope, outflow and evolutionary stage?

recipe.goal: Image continuum and line cubes and combine arrays
recipe.method: CASA clean with natural weighting; image-plane feather for continuum, C18O, N2D+, DCN; uv-plane concat for CO
key_parameters: Cube velocity widths 0.1 (C18O, N2D+), 0.5 (DCN), 1.0 (CO, SiO) km/s

recipe.goal: Measure continuum flux, size and inclination
recipe.method: 2D Gaussian fitting of each continuum image for total flux, peak flux and deconvolved size; inclination from the major to minor axis ratio

recipe.goal: Derive dust and gas mass, column density and number density from the continuum
recipe.method: Optically thin, isothermal dust emission, M_dust = F d^2 / (kappa B(T_dust)); gas mass with gas-to-dust ratio 100
assumptions: Optically thin emission and isothermal dust

recipe.goal: Derive envelope column density and mass from C18O
recipe.method: Optically thin LTE C18O column density formula, then mass from solid angle, distance and mean molecular weight
key_parameters: X(C18O) = 1.7e-7; S mu^2 = 0.02 Debye^2; Eu/k = 15.8 K; Tex = 20 K; mean molecular weight 2.8; flux above 7 sigma
assumptions: Optically thin C18O, LTE, Tex = 20 K

recipe.goal: Derive outflow mass, momentum, energy, timescale, mass-loss rate, force and kinetic luminosity from CO
recipe.method: Same LTE optically thin formulas with X(CO) = 1e-4 and Eu/k = 16.59 K; blue and red lobes integrated separately; pixels above 3 sigma per channel; inclination 45 deg corrections; t_dyn = l_flow / v_max
key_parameters: X(CO) = 1e-4, Eu/k = 16.59 K, Tex = 20 K, pixels above 3 sigma
assumptions: Disk inclination i = 45 deg; LTE; optically thin; Tex = 20 K

recipe.goal: Compare MMS 3 outflow with other regions to infer evolutionary stage
recipe.method: Compared outflow size, mass, force and bolometric luminosity with Class 0/I outflows in OMC-2/3 and Taurus
